name: domaine
description: Domaine marketplace for Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: fnd
plugins.description: Domaine Foundation skills — Agentic Assisted Development workflow for Shopify theme work.

plugins.name: slim
plugins.description: Universal result proxy for Claude Code — compresses large MCP, Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch, Grep, Glob and Agent results, pasted prompt data and @-mentioned files by content (JSON, logs, HTML, Figma REST node trees, plain-text windows), guards spill reads, and adds two tools: lookup answers one question about a page, command or file; view compacts a file or a command output (with jq narrowing, media resize and video frames) into a workspace file.

plugins.name: band
plugins.description: Status band, Log pane and Progress pane for Claude Code: draws the session's figures above the prompt and the event log and task checklist that fnd and slim publish; reads fnd and slim state.
